title: Tracking Things That Move: A Constant Velocity Filter for Each Object, Association by Distance, and the Three Ways It Goes Wrong

questions.question: Why does a planner need a velocity as well as a position of a person?
options: It needs where they will be, and a position alone is where they were
questions.explanation: A plan is for the future.

questions.question: The velocity error of the difference of two positions was:
questions.explanation: A position error of 5 cm over 0.1 s is 0.7 m/s.

questions.question: A track was confirmed after how many frames?
A target hidden for 8 frames came out with:
options: A new id: the track had been dropped

questions.question: How well was the position 2 s ahead of a walking person predicted?
questions.explanation: The track's velocity times two seconds.

questions.question: Why can two targets that stop side by side swap ids?
options: When they are close the detections of one are nearer the prediction of the other
